chapter: Early life and the plantation brass band
title: String band dances at Deer Range and when it started
summary: Brass and string bands both played dances, waltzes and jazz, with Jim Robinson in the string band. Kelly says there was no string band when he was a boy and it began after he took up music. Chris Kelly is named among its players.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Sure used to play the dances out there. Sometimes the brass band would play the dances and sometimes the string band played the dances. Jim Robinson and Jim Lindler and all them, we was playing in the old Chester band. Yeah, string band.
What kind of music did you use for the dance? Did you have any waltzes or what kind of music did they use?
They had waltzes and jazz. In jazz? Yes.
Did you ever play in a string band?
Nobody played in a string band. Nobody played in a string band. Nobody.

Nobody played in a string band. I was there always a string band there. Can you remember when it started or was there always a string band on Dave Ames there? What kind of string band did they have? Did they always have a string band there? string band band?

How far back, when you were a little boy, what kind of music did they have when you were a little boy, say seven or eight years old? Can you remember any kind of music you heard when you were, before you took up music? Mm-mm.
We didn't have anything. Not down there. Nothing down there?
No, not that way. Just the bass band?
Mm-hmm. I can't lie, they didn't have it down there, then.
Do you remember about when it was that they started that string band?
Can I remember when they started that string band? Yeah, was it after you took up music? Yeah.
Oh, it was after. Yeah. Yeah.
After. This boy was sitting around, he used to play the ambulance. Do you know that?
Jim Robbins, who used to play that, and my brother Chris Kelly.
